newsitem.title: ITALY: Goldman cuts San Paolo EPS estimates, ups Credit.
newsitem.headline: Goldman cuts San Paolo EPS estimates, ups Credit.

text.p: U.S. investment bank Goldman Sachs reduced its forecast earnings per share (EPS) for San Paolo di Torino in 1997 and 1998, while raising its earnings estimates for Credito Italiano.

For the Turin-based bank, Goldman has cut its EPS forecast for 1997 to 796 lire per share from 805 lire, and that for 1998 to 1,001 lire from 1,072 lire due to pressure on margins, an analyst at the investment bank said. The stock was confirmed as market underperformer.

For Credito Italiano, already on the priority list of Goldman, its earnings forecast for 1997 is now seen at 190 lire from 183 lire previously, and is being raised to 250 lire from 245 lire for 1998 due to increased profits from interest income and the continued rise in Credito's asset management activities.
